description:
At ten years old, Tommy Jackson says he hid from his father and prayed to Jesus for protection. He says his father never hit him again after that moment.

Tommy describes that prayer as the beginning of a real relationship with Jesus — one that helped him discover the love of a Heavenly Father when he felt he lacked it from his earthly one.

author: Russell Brand
description:
Russell reads from Romans 8, reflecting on the idea that we’re not meant to live as slaves to fear, but as children of God who can cry out, “Abba, Father.” The moment takes a funny turn when everyone immediately thinks of ABBA the band, but beneath the joke is a deeper point: we’re not only God’s children, but heirs — even co-heirs with Christ — invited to live as fully loved sons and daughters.
